messages:
eli: quick heads-up 11 fallback auth mismatches when Hosted routes fall back to Dedicated/Private. we need a minimal, repeatable handshake.

sara: +1. saw aud + alg issues; each fix is special-cased today. messy.

diego: propose a tiny bridge JWT minted by control-plane: {iss: redwood-bridge, aud: runtime-id, sub: tenant-id, scope: invoke-inference, exp: now+30s, orig_ref: <opaque>}. runtime verifies iss + signature via published JWK. no decryption/key scopes.

nina: runtime must enforce scope/aud checks and never allow bridge tokens to access KMS or admin APIs. audit every issuance.

diego: rotation: publish JWKs, support key overlap window (7 days). runtimes cache keys locally and refresh periodically.

sara: perf goals: cached path <5ms, cold issuance <25ms. also benchmark PoP vs bearer; PoP adds CPU but improves provenance.

nina: opt-in: tenant.manifest.bridge_enabled = true|false. default false for Private. air-gapped customers: operator bundle with signed bridge pubkey + manifest install instructions.

deploy-bot: canary: credential-bridge v0.1 rolling to staging (3 pods) 1767000030

eli: action items: diego draft RFC + jwk/rotation notes, sara run perf microbenchmarks, nina draft audit + air-gap operator doc. I'll wire tenant manifest flag and console toggle. will ping when RFC is ready. :thumbsup:
